title: Finalize authentication-gated interactive flow and configurable quiz length

requirements.text: Enforce a Sign In / Sign Up first-start experience with proper authentication gating: unauthenticated users must be redirected to the Login flow when attempting to access any protected module (Dashboard, Resume, Analysis, Domain/Job Role/Eligibility, Learning Plan, Quiz, Interview, Progress).

quotes: begin with the sign in or sign up if not register and proper authentication should be there

acceptanceCriteria: When not authenticated, navigating directly to any protected route (e.g., /dashboard, /quiz, /progress) redirects to /login and does not render protected content.
When authenticated, protected routes render inside the existing AppShell/AuthGate layout as they do today.
After successful Internet Identity login, users land on /dashboard (or, if no profile exists, the existing AuthGate profile setup is shown and then the user can proceed).

requirements.text: Update the Register (Sign Up) UX to work correctly with Internet Identity: provide an interactive sign-up path that initiates Internet Identity (instead of disabled username/password inputs) and clearly explains that registration is completed via Internet Identity on first login.

quotes: begin with the sign in or sign up if not register and proper authentication should be there

acceptanceCriteria: /register provides a working call-to-action that triggers Internet Identity authentication (same mechanism as Login).
After completing Internet Identity authentication from /register, the app proceeds through the same authenticated flow as /login (profile setup via AuthGate if needed, then dashboard).
All user-facing copy on /register is in English and does not imply username/password registration.

requirements.text: Modify the Quiz flow so it begins by asking the user how many questions they want, and then runs a quiz with exactly that many questions (no more, no fewer), including correct progress indicators and results summary based on that count.

quotes: and the quiz should begin with asking how many questions and should give accordingly

acceptanceCriteria: Before starting the quiz questions, the Quiz page shows a setup step that asks for the number of questions (with validation to prevent invalid values).
Starting the quiz generates/renders exactly the selected number of questions, and the UI reflects that count in “Question X of Y” and the progress bar calculation.
The results view shows scoring and review for exactly the same number of questions the user selected.
Saving quiz results still calls the backend via the existing saveQuizResults flow, and the Progress page reflects the new quiz attempt after completion.

requirements.text: Ensure all major modules function end-to-end without dead-ends: users can complete the primary flow (auth → profile setup → resume upload → analysis → domain selection → job role selection → eligibility check → learning plan → quiz → interview → progress) with clear CTAs, robust empty states, and no runtime errors when prerequisite data is missing.

quotes: give the full interactive look to the project
all the modules should function properly

acceptanceCriteria: Each page that depends on prior data (e.g., Analysis without a resume, Eligibility without a selected role) shows a clear English empty-state message and a button linking to the prerequisite step, instead of crashing or rendering broken UI.
All existing backend calls used by the pages are handled gracefully on errors (e.g., unauthorized traps, missing records) with a visible error state and recovery navigation.
Completing actions updates state consistently across the app (e.g., uploading a resume updates Dashboard/Analysis availability; completing quiz/interview updates Progress).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend changes there and create backend/migration.mo only if stable state layout changes require it.

Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed as immutable (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx). Compose around them instead.
Authentication must use Internet Identity (no username/password auth).
Use English for all user-facing text.
nonGoals: Integrating external AI services (OpenAI/Anthropic/etc.) or third-party auth providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding new modules beyond the existing VidyaMitra scope; focus is on making current modules fully functional and interactive.
Adding external databases or non-Internet-Computer backend services.
